audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-17 OPENER PART TWO - A Wizard With A Difference by James M. Ward (print 10-13, PDF 12-15, the Movement explanations riding print 15, PDF 17), the eight specialized wizard variants: the chance-of-making grid (100, 85, 75, 50, 40, 30, 20, 10 at First through Eighth Level, plus 5 percent per caster level over the first, two spells picked per level, the worked fifth-level heat-ray example with its +20 and the 1-50 roll), the spell-offer count grid (the eight types by the eight level bands, 206 spells offered, the Movement fifth-level row never printing, the unlabeled three-spell Control overflow row, 22 changed spells and 54 new spells under the printed one-star and two-star legend), and the explanation doctrines: the wizard of aggression (the Magic Missile extra arrow per level, the Hold Person 1-6 over 1-4, the Magic Spear three-plus-one per four levels, the Dancing Magic Sword plus 1 for four turns, the Melt red-hot-in-one-turn melt-the-next with the plate-mail mass limit), the wizard of defense (Shield AC 2 for five turns plus level, the chaotic minus-one Protection from Evil for six turns, the sword and edged-weapon and all-weapons protections with the save-to-hit doctrine, the Repulsion Field, the Etherialness, the No Punctures with its instant unfelt healing), the wizard of all things rustic (the ten-turn communicates, the 20-die thinking earth elemental that vanishes rather than turns on a lapsing caster, the feline, canine and avian summons with the Roc excluded and the one-full-turn vanish), the wizard of control (the Sleep draws of two beings at five dice and one at six, the staff-of-commanding once, the Charm Golems cutting golem protection down to the 14th-level save), the wizard of tenaciousness (the two-dispel wizard lock, the 60-yard sword and crossbow holds at 2-20, the 3-30 staffs and rings, the 1-10 monster hold stopping regeneration and breath, the 30-yard six-turn Stop Magic, the 12-being group hold, the 40-by-30 foot openings lasting 24 hours with the caster free to leave, the one-hour dispel-only locked openings, the End Arcane Walls), the wizard of detection (the 1-4-plus-level Find Traps, the 1-6-plus-level End Surprise, the 24-hour Reveal the Way and Divine Any Object, the Transport to the Spot carrying 1-6 beings within 20 feet after the over-six-hour study), the wizard of fire (the +1 per die fire ball that never touches its caster but does his equipment, the 10-die wall persisting 1-4, the 20-die thinking elemental, Fire Resistance 1-10, the 10-dice Heat Ray striking even fire types, the 10-yard 1-10 Fire Immunity, the five-dice-per-turn Combustion, the 5-50 Fire Vision), and the wizard of movement (the Water Travel five full turns, the Negate Fly 1-5, the Negate Water 1-6, the run-toward-the-fled Negate, the 20-being Mass Teleport, the three-plus-level Etherialness, the twice-printed End All Barriers with both its 1-10 vanish and its giant-disintegrate readings pinned, the Safe Teleport that never comes high or low). The pin IS the conversion: OD&D-era ink adjudicated to 1e terms, noted never silent; the as-scanned garbles ride the data file and the comments.

banner.title: The Dragon issue-17 opener part two - A Wizard With A Difference: the eight Ward area-wizard variants, the chance-of-making grid, the spell-list roster and the explanation doctrines
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 3 (August 1978), the Curtiss-provided scan voice (single voice: the issue-17 source is the uploaded Dm17.pdf with its mistral-ocr transcript; no archive.org djvu cross-check exists for issue 17). PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE MINUS TWO, verified at the page feet. The article prints at folios 10-13 (PDF 12-15), its list pages broken by the Strategists Club ballot at folio 12 and its Movement explanations riding folio 15 (PDF 17) alongside the R931-pinned Sights and Sounds; the cont. overleaf footer at folio 13 closes there. The pin IS the conversion: OD&D-era ink adjudicated to 1e terms, the conversion noted, never silent; Dragon pins ride a VARIANT layer with provenance, never core canon.
banner.sentinel: Print quirks pinned AS SCANNED, noted never silent: the single-voice transcript garbles ride the data file and the comments, never silently normalized - Dispel! Magic (the Defense third-level row), Pall-wall (the Movement fourth-level Pass-wall), Extention, Telekenisis, Ventriliquism, Animate Deat, the Defense-list Etherfulness against the explanation-head Etherialness, the Movement explanation-head Etheriainess, Replusion Field, Hold Staffs in the list against Hold Staff in the explanation, the lowercase Fire immunity, the Movement list skipping its Fifth Level row and printing no ordinal for it, the Control overflow row printing without its level label, and the End All Barriers explanation printing twice with two different texts - both pinned, the dupe noted as scanned. No printed grid in this article carries a garbled numeric cell: the chance grid and the roster counts pin clean, so no table cell rides a sentinel this round.

bools.comment: the changed Find the Path works as the cleric spell (print 13)

bools.name: wzdDetRevealFootstepsGlow
bools.comment: the Reveal the Way makes the actual footsteps or claw steps of the fleeing being glow before the caster (print 13)

bools.name: wzdDetRevealFlightPathGlow
bools.comment: the Reveal the Way glows the flight path when the quarry flew away (print 13)

bools.name: wzdDetDivineWillowWand
bools.comment: the Divine Any Object uses a willow wand to feel the way to the known object or being (print 13)

bools.name: wzdDetTransportMustStudy
bools.comment: the Transport to the Spot needs the caster to know exactly what is transported near - studied, mentally projected, transported safely (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireBallNeverAffectsCaster
bools.comment: the fire wizard is never affected by his own fire ball (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireBallEquipmentNotProtected
bools.comment: the fire wizard equipment is however affected by his own fire ball (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireIllusionsFireOnly
bools.comment: the changed Phantasmal Force Fire Illusions makes only illusions dealing with fire (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireNegationDestroysContactedFire
bools.comment: the new Fire Negation destroys any fire the caster comes in contact with, lasting 2-20 melee turns (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireControlRedirectOnSave
bools.comment: the new Control of Fire throws directed fire spells back at the thrower when the caster makes the magic saving throw, lasting 2-20 melee turns (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireConjureElementalThinks
bools.comment: the conjured fire elemental thinks for itself and vanishes on lost concentration rather than attacking the caster (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireBodyInfernoCasterDice
bools.comment: the new Body of Fire turns the caster into an inferno for the number of dice or hit points he has, lasting 2-20 melee turns (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireHeatRayHitsFireTypes
bools.comment: the Heat Ray damages any creature, even a fire type creature (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireImmunityAllBeingsInRadius
bools.comment: the Fire Immunity covers all beings in the radius, not the caster alone (print 13)

bools.name: wzdFireVisionNeedsLitFire
bools.comment: the Fire Vision sees into any area with a lit fire (print 13)

bools.name: wzdMovNegateRunTowardFled
bools.comment: the new Negate the Ability to Run from a Fight forces the fleeing being, on a failed magic save, to run toward the very creature it sought to flee (print 15)

bools.name: wzdMovMassTeleportAsTeleport
bools.comment: the Mass Teleport acts in all other respects as the teleport spell, to the area the caster mentally envisions (print 15)

bools.name: wzdMovEtherialnessPlusLevel
bools.comment: the Movement Etherialness duration adds the caster level (print 15)

bools.name: wzdMovEndBarrierPrintedTwice
bools.comment: the End All Barriers explanation prints TWICE with two different texts - the vanish-for-1-10 reading and the giant-disintegrate reading, both pinned, the dupe noted as scanned (print 15)

bools.name: wzdMovEndBarrierGiantDisintegrate
bools.comment: the second End All Barriers text reads as a giant disintegrate that unblocks anything stopping the wizard of movement (print 15)

bools.name: wzdMovSafeTeleportNoHighLow
bools.comment: the changed Safe Teleport matches the normal teleport except the caster never comes high or low on the target (print 15)

bools.name: wzdMovWaterTravelCastOnOthers
bools.comment: the Water Travel allows the user or the being the caster casts it on to walk on water (print 15)

data_files.content:
# The Dragon #17 - A Wizard With A Difference (James M. Ward)
# The as-scanned spell rosters, print 10-13 (PDF 12-15),
# the Movement explanations riding print 15 (PDF 17).
# PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE MINUS TWO in this issue.
# Garbles preserved as scanned: Dispel! Magic, Pall-wall,
# Extention, Telekenisis, Ventriliquism, Animate Deat,
# Etherfulness, Etheriainess, Replusion Field, Hold
# Staffs vs Hold Staff, the lowercase Fire immunity, the
# twice-printed End All Barriers explanation. The printed
# legend: * = changed for the area, ** = new.

CHANCE OF MAKING ANY SPELL PER LEVEL (print 10):
First 100 percent, Second 85, Third 75, Fourth 50,
Fifth 40, Sixth 30, Seventh 20, Eighth 10.

WIZARD OF AGGRESSION (print 10):
1: Charm Person, Sleep, Magic Missile*
2: Phantasmal Force, Web
3: Hold Person*, Fire Ball, Lightning Bolt, Slow Spell
4: Polymorph Others, Confusion, Charm Monster, Fear, Magic Spear**
5: Death Spell, Disintegrate
6: Delayed Blast Fire Ball, Power Word Stun
7: Power Word Blind, Symbol, Dancing Magic Sword**
8: Power Word Kill, Meteor Swarm, Melt**

WIZARD OF DEFENSE (print 10):
1: Shield*, Protection from Evil*
2: Invisibility, Darkness, Mirror Image
3: Dispel! Magic, Protection from Evil 10' Radius*,
   Invisibility 10' Radius, Infravision, Haste,
   Protection from Normal Missiles, Rope Trick
4: Remove Curse, Dimension Door
5: Teleport, Pass-wall, Protection from Swords**
6: Projected Image, Anti-Magic Shell,
   Protection from Edged Weapons**
7: Phase Door, Mass Invisibility, Repulsion Field**
8: Mind Blank, Prismatic Wall, Maze, Etherfulness**,
   No Punctures**, Protection from All Weapons**

WIZARD OF TENACIOUSNESS (print 10):
1: Hold Portal*
2: Wizard Lock*, Knock*
3: Hold Person, Hold Swords**, Hold Crossbows**
4: Extention I, Hold Staffs**, Hold a Cube of
   Force**, Hold Rings**
5: Hold Wands**, Hold Monster**, Telekenisis,
   Transmute Rock to Mud, Extension II, Stop
   Magic**, Hold Groups**
6: Repulsion, Extension III, Hold Openings**
7: Reverse Gravity, Permanent Spell
8: Time Stop, Wizard Lock Openings**, End Arcane
   Walls**

WIZARD OF DETECTION (print 11):
1: Detect Magic, Read Magic, Read Languages
2: Detect Invisible, Locate Object, Detect Evil, ESP
3: Clairvoyance, Clairaudience, Find Traps*,
   Infravision
4: Wizard Eye, Contact Higher Plane, Find Secret
   Doors*
5: Legend Lore, End Surprise**
6: Find the Path*, Reveal the Way**
7: Divine Any Object**
8: Transport to the Spot**

WIZARD OF FIRE (print 11):
1: Fire Ball*, Phantasmal Force Fire Illusions*
2: Pyrotechnics, Explosive Runes
3: Wall of Fire*, Fire Negation**
4: Delayed Blast Fire Ball, Control of Fire**
5: Conjure Fire Elemental*, Body of Fire**
6: Fire Resistance*, Heat Ray**
7: Fire Immunity**, Melt**
8: Combustion of All Things**, Fire Vision**

WIZARD OF MOVEMENT (print 11):
1: Levitate, Knock, Fly
2: Slow, Haste, Water Breathing, Polymorph Self
3: Water Travel**, Dimension Door
4: Negate the Ability to Fly**, Negate the Ability
   to Move on or in the Water**, Negate the Ability
   to Run from a Fight**, Teleport, Pall-wall
(no Fifth Level row prints)
6: Lower Water, Part Water, Move Earth, Phase Door
7: Reverse Gravity, Time Stop, Mass Teleport **
8: Etherialness*, End All Barriers**, Safe Teleport*

WIZARD OF ALL THINGS RUSTIC (print 11-12):
1: Light*, Strength, Continual Light
2: Wall of Ice, Growth/Plant, Massmorph,
   Hallucinatory Terrain
3: Communicate with Mammals**, Communicate with
   Plants**, Communicate with Reptiles**,
   Communicate with Insects**, Communicate with
   Avians**, Communicate with Monsters**, Ice
   Storm, Command as the Staff**
4: Charm Insect**, Charm Snake*, Charm Mammal**,
   Insect Plague, Growth/Animal
5: Conjure Earth Elemental*, Transmute Rock to Mud,
   Wall of Stone, Wall of Iron, Animate Deat,
   Summon Felines**, Summon Canines**, Summon
   Avians**
6: Lower Water, Part Water, Reincarnation, Move
   Earth, Control Weather
7: Limited Wish, Charm Plant, Reverse Gravity
8: Clone, Shapechange, Wish

WIZARD OF CONTROL (print 12):
1: Charm Person, Sleep*, Ventriliquism
2: Levitate, ESP, Magic Mouth
3: Fly, Infravision, Water Breathing
4: Suggestion, Monster Summoning I
5: Polymorph Self, Charm Monster, Monster
   Summoning II
6: Conjure Elemental, Animate Dead, Magic Jar,
   Monster Summoning III
7: Stone to Flesh, Invisible Stalker, Geas, Control
   Weather, Monster Summoning IV
8: Simulacrum, Monster Summoning V, Control as the
   Staff**, Mass Charm, Polymorph Any Object
(unlabeled overflow row): Gate, Monster
   Summoning VI, Astral Spell, Charm Golems**
